record.name: Saboteur
record.description: Saboteurs are masters of destruction and disruption. They excel at disabling enemy systems, creating explosive devices, and using their engineering knowledge to turn technology against their enemies.

subclass_identity_profile.core_fantasy: Masters of destruction and disruption. They excel at disabling enemy systems, creating explosive devices, and using their engineering knowledge to turn technology against their enemies.

progression_tree.description: You gain expertise in one type of sabotage techniques, such as electronics or mechanics. You also learn how to analyze and disable enemy systems.
You can now create simple explosive devices. You also gain expertise in Perception to detect hidden traps or enemy systems.
You gain access to sabotage tools, such as lockpicks and wrenches. You also learn how to create complex explosive devices.
You can now use your engineering knowledge to blow up areas, creating a blast radius and clearing obstacles. You also gain expertise in Athletics to navigate through complex terrain.
You are now a master of sabotage, able to analyze and disable even the most complex enemy systems. You also gain expertise in all skills related to engineering.

dynamic_visuals.combat_stance: Saboteurs adopt a crouched stance, coiled and ready to strike at a moment's notice, their eyes fixed intently on the task at hand.
dynamic_visuals.energy_signature: A swirling aura of blue and purple energy surrounds them, crackling with destructive potential as they channel their mastery over technology.

prompt_schema.base_prompt: A skilled Saboteur in combat, surrounded by the aftermath of their destructive devices.
contextual_modifiers: with a background of damaged starship components
focusing on the Saboteur's face to convey intense focus and determination
